## Roku platform revenue jumps 28% on advertiser growth; device segment remains a drag

A 28% platform revenue gain with advertiser momentum confirms ROKU's ad-tech pivot is delivering; hardware drag is a known structural headwind, so monitoring platform mix shift and operating leverage is the key forward metric.

- Roku reported a 28% increase in platform revenue, driven by advertiser growth — figure cited directly in headlines.
- Device segment weakness is acknowledged but characterized as offset by platform outperformance.
- Coverage questions whether the current valuation is justified at this growth rate, indicating mixed analyst/media sentiment.
- Result reinforces the ad market strength and platform take-rate thesis for ROKU.
